meta.title: China–Africa Aid Database
meta.description: A multi-source analytical platform for China–Africa aid and development finance

brand.title: China–Africa Aid Database
brand.subtitle: A Multi-source Platform for Aid and Development Finance Analysis

home.kicker: Multi-source data · Interactive analysis · Transparent methods
home.headline: Start with data. Understand China–Africa development cooperation.
home.intro: Bringing together 12 databases on aid, loans, debt, investment, energy and health—then making them clear, comparable and traceable across trends, countries, sectors and individual records.
home.analyticsTitle: An analytical workspace built for research.
home.analyticsIntro: Move from overall coverage to individual records in one interface. Every metric retains its source, unit, time basis and quality flags.

chart.title: Database overview

descriptions.coverage: Number of source families within their known reporting window in each year.
descriptions.records: Log-scaled visual comparison of record volumes in the largest databases.
descriptions.years: Available annual-analysis span for major databases.

chart.footnote: Charts use verified file volumes and reporting windows; amounts from different metric families are not combined.

home.featuresTitle: From macro trends to individual projects.
home.featuresIntro: Capabilities are organised around research tasks, not a pile of charts. Views share country, year, sector and source filters.

compare.title: Compare databases
compare.body: Review observation levels, coverage, financial instruments, amount definitions and time bases side by side.

trend.title: Analyse trends
trend.body: Explore annual amounts, records, FDI, health assistance and energy indicators with normalized views and outlier controls.

country.title: Explore countries
country.body: Use maps, rankings and country profiles to understand coverage, sector structure and change over time.

sector.title: Study sectors
sector.body: Retain source classifications while adding a reviewable broad mapping for cross-database analysis.

records.title: Search records
records.body: Find projects, loans, debt events, power plants and units with source, definition and quality context.

quality.title: Diagnose quality
quality.body: See missingness, outliers, coverage breaks, regional records and right truncation caused by update cycles.

home.researchTitle: Put the method beside the chart.
home.researchBody: The platform keeps definitional differences visible. Every statistic explains where the data came from, what it measures and what it cannot establish.

databases.title: Data source catalogue
databases.description: Review coverage, record level, amount basis and available fields across 12 sources.

trends.title: Record trends
trends.description: View annual record counts and coverage changes by country and start year.

countries.title: Country ranking
countries.description: Filter and rank countries by name, record count and source coverage.

sectors.title: Sector comparison
sectors.description: Review original sectors alongside the broad harmonized mapping.

records.title: Record browser
records.description: Search public project, loan, debt-event, power-plant and generation-unit records.

topics.title: Thematic analysis
topics.description: Explore energy, health, debt finance, FDI and aid-export themes.

quality.title: Data quality
quality.description: Review missingness, outlier flags, coverage breaks and mapping success.

findings.title: Analysis results
findings.description: Review descriptive statistics, cross-source correlations, structural changes and robustness checks.

review.title: Match review
review.description: Review cross-database project candidates and export traceable human decisions.

methods.title: Methods and research data
methods.description: Review data processing, project matching, quality controls and research downloads.

pages.emptyBody: Real charts and records will appear after source adaptation and validation.

footer.statement: Internal research workspace · Data preparation and analysis
